title: オークスの後に・Full of Joy

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Enveloped in cheers after racing in the Japanese Oaks, Fine Motion fully embraces the joy of running!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like her joyous performance has resonated with the Umamusume she spoke to before the race too…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But with so many factors motivating other Umamusume, Fine Motion struggles to accept her inner instinct to simply race for the fun of it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While she is grappling with a vague sense of unease, Fine Motion is still looking forward to summer camp, after which the Shuka Sho awaits.
